events.what: Pak, Panova and Swanson give a positive combinatorial interpretation (marked trees) for rectangular Kronecker coefficients g(lambda,(n^k),(n^k)) with lambda of at most two rows
Harman and Wilson introduce bitableaux, reduce the general problem to a combinatorial conjecture, and prove a monomial-basis combinatorial expansion
Butbaia, Lee, Ruehle train ML models to predict vanishing of Kronecker coefficients

judgement.doubts: Agree with the record. The Pak–Panova–Swanson result settles a restricted class of Kronecker coefficients (case, not whole). Harman–Wilson is a reduction to an unproven conjecture plus a monomial-basis (not Schur-positive) expansion, so it does not set the status. The ML vanishing-prediction papers answer a different question (zero vs nonzero), a variant; their AI role does not transfer. The researcher could not fully confirm the absence of an AI acknowledgement in 2511.02312, but nothing suggests one.
